column24: Tool paper introducing HiMBar (High-Fidelity Metagenomic Barcoding), a pipeline for transkingdom species detection by extracting full-length marker genes (16S/18S rRNA, 23S/26S rRNA, 5S/5.8S rRNA, COI, rbcL) directly from HiFi metagenomic reads via HMM profiling, bypassing PCR amplification and assembly. Applied to 79 pooled eDNA samples from Bao'an Lake (Hubei, China; 4 seasons, 2019). PacBio Sequel II for HiFi metagenomics (>20 Gb; 25 Gb post-CCS, N50 9.8 kb). Outperforms short-read amplicon, full-length amplicon, and MetaPhlAn in accuracy (100% vs 13-67%) and recall (100% vs 17-83%). Detected 1,374 OTUs across 5 kingdoms from 83 phyla. Identified stable CPVF interaction module (Cyanobacteria + Planctomycetota + Verrucomicrobiota + Fungi) linked to glucose metabolism. No primary metagenome assembly or MAGs produced. Code: https://github.com/Xchenkai2019/HIFI_barcoding. Data: PRJCA025504 (NGDC/GSA).

column24: Tool paper introducing MetaRanker, a computational pipeline for antibiotic resistome risk assessment in metagenomes. Integrates abundance of ARGs (antibiotic resistance genes), MGEs (mobile genetic elements), and VFs (virulence factors) — calculated from reads — with their genetic co-occurrence on contigs into a unified Risk Index (RI). Benchmarked on 20 in silico mock samples + 103 in-house real samples + 240 public short-read samples + 10 public long-read samples (all from SRA/GSA — no new HiFi data generated). Compatible with short reads (Illumina, BWA) and long reads (PacBio/Nanopore, Minimap2). Compact database 29.6 MB; >50% faster runtime than MetaCompare 2.0. Code: https://github.com/SteamedFish6/MetaRanker.
